meta.title: Investigate checkout latency
meta.subtitle: Illustrative engineering example. Sources and findings are fictional.

effect.label: Checkout p99 exceeded 2 seconds
effect.evidence: Illustrative incident metric: p99 = 2.4 s during the release window.

causes.label: Full table scan
causes.evidence: Illustrative query plan: missing index produces a scan.

causes.label: Row lock contention
causes.evidence: Illustrative lock sampling: no concurrent lock waits.

causes.label: Connection pool exhausted
causes.evidence: Open question: correlate pool saturation with slow requests.

causes.label: Long GC pause
causes.evidence: Illustrative runtime trace: pauses under 10 ms.

causes.label: New unbounded query
causes.evidence: Illustrative diff: pagination was removed from a hot path.
